text:
The same quantity of thermal (heat) energy is given to two objects X and Y. The temperature rise
of object X is less than the temperature rise of object Y.
What accounts for this difference?
A
X has a larger thermal capacity than Y.
B
X is a better thermal conductor than Y.
C
Y has a larger thermal capacity than X.
D
Y is a better thermal conductor than X.

options.label: A
options.text: X has a larger thermal capacity than Y.

options.label: B
options.text: X is a better thermal conductor than Y.

options.label: C
options.text: Y has a larger thermal capacity than X.

options.label: D
options.text: Y is a better thermal conductor than X.
